protocol.reset: Only at recording start; no resets at event boundaries
protocol.warningWindow: Start of publisher fall process through processEnd + 3 seconds; also report process-only sensitivity
protocol.falseAlerts: Episodes in independently reviewed normal intervals only; non-event time is not automatically normal because people remain down after falls

limitations: All events are staged by capable adults.
Two synchronized views of one fall are correlated; report both camera-event counts and per-person/camera results.
No older-adult, domestic camera brand, phone throughput, or camera-day validation.
Native footage is 320x240; camera-domain shift is real.
No tuning on these recordings after the freeze; deployment is separately blocked.

review.review: Prediction-blind inspection of all ten full RGB timelines sampled every five seconds, cross-checked against the author's 80 fall-process intervals. Normal exposure uses only the prefix ending one second before the first labelled fall and the final activity sequence beginning 15 seconds after the last fall process. The latter shows recovery followed by intentional picking, sitting and lying. Intermediate fall/recovery intervals are excluded from false-alarm denominators, not relabelled as normal. This is a coarse source-label review, not independent frame-level expert annotation.

metrics: Warning episodes separated by >5 seconds of silence. New onset must fall in author process-start through process-end+3 seconds. Already-running warnings cannot rescue a later fall. False episodes overlap reviewed normal prefix/tail exposure.
limitations: All events are staged by capable adults.
Two synchronized views of one fall are correlated; report both camera-event counts and per-person/camera results.
No older-adult, domestic camera brand, phone throughput, or camera-day validation.
Native footage is 320x240; camera-domain shift is real.
No tuning on these recordings after the freeze; deployment is separately blocked.
False-alarm rates cover only reviewed normal intervals, not every non-fall frame. Do not extrapolate this short staged exposure to camera-days.
No participant/camera in this report was used for candidate selection. Do not tune on these results and reuse them as unseen.
Human safety and reliable background/mobile notifications remain unqualified.
